title: fix(i18n): console copy names the system the user is in, not the cloud noun (objectui#12956)
body:
Fixes #12956
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Inside a running deployment the console stops calling itself "this environment" / 「此环境 / 本环境」 (objectstack-ai/cloud#3002, ruling A). Every value in the card's named families that said so now says "this system" / 「本系统」, or drops the noun where the sentence reads without it. All ten packs follow. No key is renamed, added or removed (`all-locales-key-parity` green).

- **The Settings category label** (`console.settingsHub.categories.Workspace`, the manifest category that holds Company, Branding and Localization) reads "General" / 「常规」, the plainest name for what is configured there and not another cloud noun. Each pack uses the word it already uses for `organization.settings.generalTitle`.
- **Omitted rather than replaced** where the sentence reads without the noun: the sign-in-directly sentences (`auth.setPassword.description`, `home.recoveryReminder.message` in zh only, since en never named it), the three `profile.password.*` descriptions, and `home.loading` ("Loading…" / 「加载中…」).
- **`home.loading` joined the merged `Loading…` group** that `ellipsis-glyph-3878.test.ts` pins for per-language uniformity, because its en value is now exactly `Loading…`. zh and ko take the group's existing rendering (「加载中…」, 「로딩 중…」), and the pinned member list grows by that one key.
- **Inline English defaults follow en.** `pnpm check:i18n-keys` refuses an inline `defaultValue` that differs from the en value it falls back for, so the call sites' literals moved with en (see Deviations).

## A1: every value in the named families, per pack

Families: `console.settingsHub`, `console.workspaceTimezonePrompt`, `console.readRate`, `auth.*`, `profile.password`, `home.*`, `connectAgent`, `aiModelStatus`. Enumerated from the loaded packs (every string under each family, matched for the noun in each pack's script), not from line numbers. 22 keys change in all ten packs, plus `home.recoveryReminder.message` in zh only: 221 values. Every hit in these families changed; there is no "keep" row.
